title: AdmissionDecisionInvalid payload
description: The decision binds a capability twice, binds one that is not required, binds one to an implementation its exact key does not list (or, where the environment holds no `prefix.*` key, one that has no exact key), names missing one that is not required, that it binds or that the environment provides by its exact key, leaves a required one neither bound nor missing, or refuses where no capability it names missing is confirmed missing, so nothing moved.
